evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].
- On 2023-10-04, was in Boston: he told Dave he had met with artists there the day before (2023-10-03) to plan a music collaboration (continuation of the planned Boston visit from his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 flight booking above; details in ## Music) [S21T1].
- On 2023-10-25, told Dave that the day before (2023-10-24) he had a great time sightseeing in Boston with a high school friend — "really fun and eye-opening"; he found Boston "a wonderful experience" with "awesome architecture and a really cool history," and said it was "so peaceful" — following Dave's advice (continuation of his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 Boston visit, see above; details in ## Relationships) [S26T1][S26T3].
- On 2023-10-29, while looking at Dave's Boston photos (the sunset-over-the-skyline photo and a close-up of the clock tower, see the 2023-10-29 entry in ## Music and the Photography section of /memories/dave.md), Calvin recognized the clock tower and said he was in Boston a few years back — "it's such a beautiful city." (a second, separate Boston visit, in addition to his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 visit above; "a few years back" — exact date not given) [S27T5][S27T7].
- On 2023-11-13, told Dave he invited his old high school friend (the same friend he sightseeing'd with on 2023-10-24, see above) to see him perform in Boston — "It was insane!" — (recent as of 2023-11-13; the show date itself is not specified) (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S29T1].
- On 2023-11-16, attended a "fancy gala" in Boston (told Dave about it on 2023-11-17, as "yesterday") and met some interesting people; shared a photo of himself and "the crew" (a photography of a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river) (Dave: "that event looks amazing! You all look awesome."; the Boston event — details in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships) [S30T2].
- On 2023-11-17, announced to Dave that he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience!" — and said he can't wait to fill Dave in on all the details (no date or venue given; details in ## Music and in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships); Dave congratulated him on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance and said he'd maybe catch one of his shows in Boston; Calvin: "I'll catch you when I'm in Boston" [S30T20][S30T21][S30T22] (Dave's side in the Boston and Music sections of /memories/dave.md).

- On 2023-08-22, Calvin said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, proposing they meet up then (renewing the plan for Dave to show Calvin around, see above); Dave: "Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-13, when Calvin got excited about his tour spots, said live music is the best, was sure Calvin would have a blast on tour and make awesome memories, and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars — "If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!" (renewing his long-standing offer to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston, see ## Classic cars); shared a photo of his garage (a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign) — "Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!" — and said "Can't wait for your visit!"; Calvin accepted the offer ("I'll definitely take you up on that offer") and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md) [S18T10][S18T11][S18T12].
- On 2023-11-17, when Calvin announced he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston (details in the Music section of this file and in ## Music of /memories/calvin.md), said "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston. Let me know when you're free to catch up. Cheers to your musical journey!"; Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! I'll catch you when I'm in Boston. Cheers!" — and the chat closed with mutual goodbyes — Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you. Stay safe, talk to you soon!" and Calvin: "Thanks! You too. Talk to you later!" [S30T20][S30T21][S30T22][S30T23][S30T24].

- On 2023-09-02, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said he's been "tied up with car stuff lately" and came back from San Francisco the day before (2023-09-01) with "some great insights and knowledge on car modification" he wants to share with Calvin — "Changing things around, and giving an old car a new life - so satisfying!" (details in ## Car workshops in San Francisco); he said fixing stuff up is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", that fixing someone's car feels like making a difference, and that seeing their relief when their car is fixed "makes me proud!" (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin understood the satisfaction of giving things a new life and said Dave must feel great making a real difference — "like being their superhero!" — and should be proud [S17T1][S17T2][S17T3][S17T4][S17T5]. Calvin then said he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is so excited about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Cool! Let me know when you're free and we can catch up in Boston."; Calvin: "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. See you soon!" [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat then closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!" — looking forward to seeing Calvin in Boston and wishing him a safe trip [S17T9]; Calvin thanked him, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T10].

- On 2023-10-29, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Dave!"): Calvin told him that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "So cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "Super excited about what it could lead to" (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T1]. Dave then told Calvin he's been getting into photography recently — he's "seen some amazing places and taken some great shots" — and offered to show Calvin them (details in the Photography section of this file) [S27T2]; Calvin: "Yeah, show me what you got!" [S27T3]. Dave shared two Boston photos: first, a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower — "Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!" (Calvin: "Wow, that view looks awesome! What city is it?") [S27T4][S27T5]; second, a photo of the clock tower in the city with buildings around it, which he took last month (~September 2023) at sunset — "got a great shot - it was stunning!" (Calvin: "Wow, that pic is amazing!") [S27T6]. Calvin recognized the clock tower ("In your last photo, is that the clock tower?") and said he was in Boston a few years back and it's "such a beautiful city. You're so talented, Dave!" (Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T5][S27T7]. Dave confirmed it is the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning — and said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (details in the Photography section of this file); Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot." [S27T7][S27T8]. The conversation continued: Calvin asked how Dave's car project was going, and Dave said he had "just finished restoring it and it looks amazing," inviting Calvin over to check it out (details in ## Classic cars), and then asked how everything was with the music ("Any updates?"); Calvin: he'd had some great collaborations recently and his album is almost finished, and he'll send Dave some previews soon (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); the chat closed with the two arranging a catch-up when one of them is free — Calvin: "Let me know when you're free for a catch-up." Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it. Let me know when you're free and take it easy!" Calvin: "Cheers! I'll let you know when I'm free. Bye!" [S27T9][S27T10][S27T11][S27T12][S27T13].

question.question: Based on the conversation, did Calvin and Dave have a meeting in Boston between August and November 2023? Answer in yes or no.
